svg.aria-label: How I work. (+MVP). I build to sell from version one.. Groundwork first: The legal and operational groundwork comes before the first line of code.. Only what launch needs: Nothing gets built that the launch does not need.. Ship when it is ready: A visible but harmless flaw never delays a launch that is otherwise ready.
